value: Google Threat Intelligence Group AI Threat Tracker of 2026-05-11: a criminal zero-day 2FA-bypass exploit GTIG believes was AI-developed, prepared for planned mass exploitation that disclosure may have prevented; LLM-generated decoy code in CANFAIL and LONGSTREAM; the Gemini-driven Android backdoor PROMPTSPY; PRC and DPRK actors using Gemini for vulnerability research; LLM account pooling; and TeamPCP supply-chain attacks on AI components.

Cyber-espionage cluster targeting global telecommunications providers and government organizations, per Mandiant/Google Threat Intelligence Group (2026-09), using a backdoor that hides command-and-control inside legitimate cloud productivity-spreadsheet traffic; formerly tracked as UNC2814 under Google's updated threat-actor naming system. GTIG's May 2026 AI Threat Tracker names UNC2814 as a PRC state actor using expert-persona prompting in Gemini for vulnerability research into TP-Link firmware and OFTP implementations.
Cyberattack on some Foxconn North American factories, confirmed on 2026-05-12 and claimed by the Nitrogen ransomware group with 8 TB of alleged customer project data.
Compromise of the jdownloader.org CMS that pointed the Windows alternative-installer and Linux shell-installer links to malware on 6 and 7 May 2026.
Unauthorized access to a BWH Hotels (Best Western, WorldHotels, Sure Hotels) guest-reservation web application from 2025-10-14 until its discovery on 2026-04-22.

UK ICO fine of £963,900 under UK GDPR (Articles 5(1)(f) and 32(1)) on South Staffordshire for a 2020 to 2022 intrusion: a phishing foothold undetected for 20 months, ZeroLogon on two unpatched domain controllers, and only 5% of the IT environment monitored (ICO, 2026-05-11).
AWS account breach at the Braintrust AI-evaluation platform exposing customers' org-level AI provider keys.
Akira ransomware attack on Groupe 3R (Réseau Radiologique Romand), a Swiss medical-imaging network, with administrative data stolen and published (victim-confirmed); 48 GB claimed.

rel.note: the victim attributes the attack to Akira on methods its partners observed
The Record and The Register name Clop; the ICO names no actor

value: Successive 2026 SPIP CMS security releases tracked by CERT-FR: multiple RCEs in versions before 4.4.14 (CERTFR-2026-AVI-0564) followed by a security-policy bypass fixed in 4.4.15 (CERTFR-2026-AVI-0635).
Centreon Infrastructure Monitoring April 2026 bulletin: an RCE, SQL-injection and XSS vulnerability cluster relayed by CERT-FR (CERTFR-2026-AVI-0572).
SMS-blaster smishing in Switzerland, reported by BACS since September 2025: portable fake base stations force a 2G downgrade to bypass operator SMS filtering.

entity.name: Nitrogen
entity.summary: Ransomware group first observed in 2023 and believed to use a builder based on the Conti ransomware (Barracuda, via The Record); Coveware documented a bug in its ESXi encryptor that leaves files unrecoverable (2026-02-02). Claimed the May 2026 attack on Foxconn's North American factories.

rel.note: claimed on its leak site; Foxconn names no actor
